newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: ALPINE SKIING-PANZANINI CELEBRATES SECOND WIN OF THE SEASON.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PANZANINI CELEBRATES SECOND WIN OF THE SEASON.

text.p: Italy's Sabina Panzanini recorded her second victory of the World Cup season in a women's Alpine skiing giant slalom on Friday.
Panzanini produced the quickest second run to improve on a first-leg fifth place for a winning aggregate time of two minutes 34.74.
The 24-year-old topped the podium at a giant slalom in Park City, Utah, in November.
First-run leader Deborah Compagnoni, the Olympic and world champion, and Austria's Anita Wachter shared second place in 2:34.82 on the Pohorje piste in snowy and foggy conditions.
Slovenian Urska Hrovat, third after the first run, disappointed home crowds by failing to make the podium. She finished fourth in 2:35.23.
Germans Martina Ertl and Katja Seizinger were fifth and sixth respectively.
